title: conophytum labyrintheum

This plant is known for its unique, button-like appearance and is often used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Conophytum labyrintheum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
